Name: Reverse Transmutation
Author: eCustic
Description:
A very simple[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915] Content Patcher[/url] mod which adds two new crafting recipes:

[b]Reverse Transmute (Cu)
[/b]1 x Iron Bar -> 3 x Copper Bar

[b]Reverse Transmute (Fe)
[/b]1 x Gold Bar -> 2 x Iron Bar

Both recipes are based on the vanilla recipes for transmutation, just reversed. Meaning that they have the same conditions (Mining lvl. 4 and 7 respectively).

Manifest.Name: Reverse Transmutation
Manifest.Description: Adds recipes for transmuting metals in reverse.
